entries.name: Mech
entries.style: low-poly, hard-surface, rusty painted texture flattened to flat colours (Quaternius 2021)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Animated Mech Pack ships four mechs (George, Leela, Mike, Stan); Stan, the armed humanoid with a boxy head and blade feet, reads most clearly as a mech. Built from the pack .blend (the FBX has no texture link and doubles every action). The source is teal with orange stripes and rust; indigo has no teal, so the armour is recoloured accent red with pale frame and gold stripes. Height 3 m: a small walker mech, about 1.7 x human height.
